blocks.p: The picture on the monitor of the desk is the wallpaper, and there are two to choose from. The original wallpaper is the game's old title painting. The new wallpaper is the Build 42 title video, which plays on the monitor.

caption: Figure 46-1
The original wallpaper. The Settings menu is shown enlarged.

marks.text: Original wallpaper: the game's old title painting.

sticky.text: Two wallpapers for the desk's monitor.

blocks.p: To change the wallpaper, open the *Settings* menu in the menu bar and choose *Original wallpaper* or *New wallpaper*. A square marks the one in use. The same menu opens *Options*, *Mods* and the *Workshop*.

caption: Figure 46-2
The new wallpaper, with the menu enlarged.

marks.text: New wallpaper: the Build 42 title video plays on the monitor.

sticky.text: A square marks the one in use.
